core.title: Grade 2 Turn x Turn Deadbolt, Falcon D251
tags: Falcon D251 Grade 2 Turn by Turn Deadbolt

text.description_html:
Falcon D251, Thumbturn x Thumbturn Deadbolt

This is a Thumbturn x Thumbturn deadbolt where the deadbolt is thrown or retracted by use of a thumbturn unit from either side. This Falcon D251 Grade 2 Turn x Turn Deadbolt is most often used on tornado shelters.

Thumbturn x Thumbturn: The deadbolt is thrown and retracted by a thumbturn on both the exterior and the interior.]

Features and Specifications of the :

  • ANSI A156.5, 2001, Grade 2 auxiliary lock.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: Adjustable 2-3/8” or 2-3/4”
  • Deadbolt: 1-1/8" x 2 1/4", Square corner faceplate, 1" housing diameter, 1" throw.
  • Strike: 1-1/8" x 2 3/4", lipless, with box.
  • Metal dust box reinforcer with 3" screws
  • 1" Wrought brass or bronze, reinforced with security insert.

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
